description:
Metadata contains fields common to every resource. The presence of
 `file_type` (and its default of `definition`) lets the catalog tell
 authoritative resource files apart from overlay fragments without
 needing to inspect every other field.

^(fileType)$.description:
What kind of file this metadata block belongs to. Defaults to
 `definition` when omitted (the historical / authoritative
 resource-file shape). Set to `overlay` on overlay fragments so
 the catalog walker can skip them without name/kind heuristics.
^(fileType)$.title: Enum

file_type.description:
What kind of file this metadata block belongs to. Defaults to
 `definition` when omitted (the historical / authoritative
 resource-file shape). Set to `overlay` on overlay fragments so
 the catalog walker can skip them without name/kind heuristics.
file_type.title: Enum

hooks.description:
Resource-local hooks declared inline on the resource yaml. Paths
 are resolved relative to the resource file's directory. Only
 `render` entries are honored on resources today; the runner
 rejects `dependents` and `validate` entries. Resource render
 hooks run after the kind's `render` + dependents, and before the
 kind's `validate` lifecycle. They let resource definers customize
 the rendered bundle without expanding the kind spec.

dependents.description:
Per-consumer dependent hooks. Each entry binds a consumer kind to
 hook(s) that run when a resource of that kind declares a
 dependency on this one, plus the params schema the consumer must
 supply. See SPEC.md "Dependencies" for the full design.

items.description:
DependentDefinition declares a consumer kind that may depend on this
 kind, the hook file path(s) that run when such a dependency is
 rendered, and the JSON Schema describing the `params` the consumer
 must supply.

^(paramsPath)$.description:
Path to the JSON Schema describing the `params` object that the
 consumer must supply when declaring this dependency. Resolved
 relative to the enclosing kind.json file.

kind.description: The consumer kind that may depend on this resource.

params_path.description:
Path to the JSON Schema describing the `params` object that the
 consumer must supply when declaring this dependency. Resolved
 relative to the enclosing kind.json file.

paths.description:
Paths to hook files that run when a resource of `kind` declares a
 dependency on this resource. At least one entry is required. Hooks
 run in declaration order. Paths are resolved relative to the
 enclosing kind.json file.

items.title: Dependent Definition

render.description:
Hooks run during `veil render` (each exports a Hook whose optional
 `renderHook(ctx, fs)` transforms the bundle). Each entry is an
 object with a required `path` plus optional `access` declaring the
 host resources the hook may read.

items.description:
RenderHookDefinition is a single render-hook entry in kind.json: a
 path to the hook source file plus optional `access` declaring the
 host resources the hook may read.

oneOf.description:
Path to the hook source file. Resolved relative to the enclosing
 kind.json file.

access.description:
Optional declaration of host resources this hook needs (env vars,
 and eventually filesystem / network as they're added).

env.description:
Environment variables the hook intends to read. Each entry must
 describe both the name and why it's needed; the description is
 surfaced in pre-flight error messages when the var is missing.

items.description: EnvAccess names a single host environment variable a hook needs.

description.description:
A brief description of what this key is used for and why. Surfaced
 when the var is missing so the user can correct the issue.

name.description:
The env var being requested by the hook. Must match the conventions
 for valid POSIX environment-variable identifiers.

items.title: Env Access

path.description:
Path to the hook source file. Resolved relative to the enclosing

items.title: Render Hook Definition

validate.description:
Validation hooks that run after every other lifecycle point
 (kind.render, dependents, and resource-level render hooks) has
 completed. Each hook receives the same context + FS as render
 hooks but any mutations are discarded by the runner; the only
 observable output is the collection of `ValidationIssue` entries
 the hook returns (or throws). Every validate hook runs regardless
 of failures so the user sees every issue at once; the render
 fails at the end with an aggregated report if any issues are
 reported.

kind.description:
The name of the kind this resource instantiates. Required when
 `file_type` is `definition`; ignored when `file_type` is
 `overlay` — overlays cannot reassign their target's kind.

name.description:
The name of this resource. Required when `file_type` is
 `definition` (the default); ignored entirely when `file_type` is
 `overlay` — overlays cannot rename their target resource.

overlays.description: Conditional overlays applied based on per-variable regex matches.

items.description:
Overlay is a conditional data merge applied before transforms. The
 overlay applies when every entry in `if` matches: the resolved
 value of each named variable (stringified) must match the
 corresponding Go regular expression.

file.description:
Path to the overlay file. Resolved relative to the resource file
 that declares this overlay, or used as-is when absolute.

if.title:
Map of variable name → regex pattern. All entries must match for
 the overlay to apply. An empty map means "always apply".

items.title: Overlay

overrides.description: Source files that have been ejected for local override.

items.description: Override maps a kind source file to a local replacement.

^(skipHooks)$.description:
When true, all hooks are skipped on this particular file. Allows
 you to bring your own files instead of using what the registry
 provides.

path.description:
Local path to the override file. Resolved relative to the
 resource file that declares this override, or used as-is when
 absolute.

skip_hooks.description:
When true, all hooks are skipped on this particular file. Allows
 you to bring your own files instead of using what the registry
 provides.

source.description: Path of the source file in the kind being replaced.
